protocol.purpose: Frozen diagnostic test of cross-subband agreement and boundary evidence; no fitting or selection
protocol.mask: Original full-band 2% peak amplitude mask intersected with disjoint subband. Lower inclusive, upper exclusive except last band upper inclusive. Each subband retains original >=12 bins per pair and LS validity thresholds.
protocol.full_candidate: Frozen cap150 from prior failed narrowband-guard study; diagnostic subject only, not accepted default
protocol.boundary: After consistency, require maximum cone angle across full candidate and every valid subband <=30deg+1e-10. This envelope is not a calibrated confidence interval or probability.
protocol.scope: 144 paired trials,3 new seeds. Fixed screens only veto original candidates; no replacement, widening, retuning or confidence calibration. All rejected/absent/transition frames still update tracker.
protocol.reporting: Report unsupported/inconsistent/boundary-uncertain separately. Check outside active fresh outputs, inside correct coverage, exactly-30deg boundary, legitimate narrowband availability, HOLD and paired latency. Lower false output with near-zero coverage is not success.

frozen_algorithms.capture: 5/12,120ms; legacy cone and acceptance thresholds unchanged

acoustic.note: 144 paired trials; all 4x4x3 conditions predeclared, no tuning/selection. 3 new seeds descriptive only. Synthetic causal image-source early RIR plus stochastic decaying tail; not calibrated room RT60.
